text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Kikuka Sho arrived, with her greatest rival, "Bruskman," absent from the field.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We arrived at the venue early
to get Kitasan Black fired up, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hmm, according to my Bakushin Intel, contenders coming from the St. Lite Kinen don't seem to fare too well in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Still! Data like this won't be an issue!
Distance won't be a problem either, of course!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black-san is already becoming
a Bakushin girl who won't be fazed by such things.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I agreed that there were no issues with the data or distance.
The lack of previous successful runs was likely just coincidence, and she can probably pull through 3,000 meters.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: More importantly, the problem is—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (I wanted... to settle this. I wanted to prove I surpassed them and finish the Triple Crown. But...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Brusque-san...
I can't believe she's withdrawing...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (I'll be fine! Even without Ms. Brusqman here, I can still run properly! I won't hesitate anymore.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (Still... will I really be satisfied after the race?)

Heeey, young lady over there, what's up?
Got something on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
ââ!!
Nature-san, what are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I asked Bakushin O, and she said you'd probably be here.
What's up? Wanna talk about it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, actually...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I thought so.
You can't help but be bothered
by the absence of your rival.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Because I was the same way.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "...Ah! Nature-san too!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yep. In my case, your beloved Teio
was out with an injury, so she wasn't there.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I worried over it so much back then.
The opponent I dreamed of beating was――

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: After all, you didn't make it in time anyway.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
What did you do
back then, Nature-san...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I spent quite a while moping like, 'How am I supposed to beat someone who isn't even here?!', but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, this is what I thought:
'It all comes down to me.'"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Myself...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yep! Whether people think of it as a race without Teio all depends on how I run, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I thought, 'I won't let them say that.'
Like I'd ever let anyone feel the void of her absence."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: This is the answer I finally came up with in my own way back then. Not sure if it'll be of any help to you, though.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Make it feel like they never left...
What they think of me will all come down to my running...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see, that's true.
You're absolutely right, Nature-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Now I feel like I can run straight ahead!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, do your best. The Kikuka Sho is a once-in-a-lifetime chance.
Just make sure you don't leave any regrets out there.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"My my, Trainer-san, what a lovely pupil you have.
I made sure to chime in just enough not to get in the way, though."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've heard the whole story. It looks like her mental state,
which was my biggest worry, will be just fine now.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I was a bit surprised.
Because unlike me back then, I thought Kitasan was on the sparkly protagonist side.”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I guess she has her vulnerable moments too.
It actually made me kind of happy, in a way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without answering, I looked up at the sky.
It's true that Kitasan Black has her weak moments, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just how strong has she become?
Her current standing will now be proven on the turf.
